rows.grounds: mahāśaktiḥ plus ca fused; subject of arising
ablative of compound meaning glory of unity of three

items.question: What arises from the glory of unity of the three?
items.inference: The verse states that great power arises from the glory of the unity of the three.
uncertainties: The exact referent of 'three' is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: A great power arises from the glory of the unity of the three.
